title: 第17章 无事献殷勤第18章 莫女神的关爱
content_zh:
待苏思蓉离开后，江凡悠闲欣赏起自己的六号别墅，纯欧式奢华装修风格，地下室有个酒窖和储藏室，一楼是门厅、客厅、厨房、餐厅、卧室之类，二楼是生活区域，三楼是工作和休息区域。
挺不错，厨房和餐厅的生活用品齐全，卧室、书房、会客厅等房间的各种家具也已配置齐全，拎包入住可以直接开火做饭，只不过一个人住一套别墅太冷清了些。
来到别墅天台，玄武湖公园尽收眼底，远眺可俯瞰鼓楼区、玄武区、秦淮区和长江对面的浦口区，也许这就是开发商口中所谓唯吾独尊霸气吧。
地球上应该没有灵石，不知道有没有其他布阵材料，有材料的话可以布置个聚灵阵，倒也算一处非常不错的修炼之地！
闭目运转《混沌造化诀》，一股股氤氲的灵气丝线从四面八方吸引而来，萦绕在江凡周围，缓缓进入体内，如玉肌肤在阳光照射下泛起熠熠光辉。
没过多久，苏思蓉再次返回六号别墅，办事很是周到，不仅买了花梨木牌匾、雕刻工具、文房四宝等，而且还顺带买了床上用品、生活用品和米面粮油厨房用品，倒是省去江凡采购物资的麻烦。
江凡雕刻牌匾那里需要书法临摹，体内灵力灌入雕刻刀中，一气呵成颏下‘苍玄小院’四个大字，再使用小号雕刻刀简单修葺、完善下，龙飞凤舞，入木三分，挂在别墅大门上颇为霸气！
简单收拾一番，江凡拎着两皮包现金来马不停蹄杀向新街口的汇丰支行，提取支票上百万现金，在隔壁工商银行重新开了个户，200万现金巨款震惊不少吃瓜群众，也体验了一把工行VIP贵宾专属服务。
没在新街口商圈闲逛，江凡又快马加鞭杀向水西门中药材批发市场，花费十万多采购十几种普通药材，又到草木堂花费八十多万采购麝香、鹿茸等名贵药材，不到两个小时花费近百万，算是凑齐一个月炼体所需淬体液的药材。
昨晚一共也就敲诈了224万，单单一个月炼体所需的药材花费近百万，下下个月的药材可能超过两百万，而银行卡余额和现金差不多还剩130万，真心有些伤不起。
没个代步工具住在紫玄山庄很不方便，便宜的汽车会拉低山庄档次，贵的汽车有点浪费钱财，摩托车貌似是个不错的选择，不堵车，停车便利，省油，还省钱。
没必要太骚包，花费八千多买了一辆雅马哈摩托车，载着两麻袋药材一路风驰电掣，差点亮瞎紫玄山庄保安的双眼，得知江凡是闲置多年六号别墅的新业主，更是一脸懵逼，六号别墅可是禁忌般的存在，新业主居然是个二十岁不到年轻人！
刚回到别墅，摩托车还没有停稳，手机便响了起来，班级好友木志乐打来的电话，班里众人在紫金山玩了一天，半小时后在天福园聚餐，催促江凡早点回学校。
如今好不容易有了个新家，晚上珍贵的时间还要修炼，哪有时间参加什么班级聚餐，果断回复人不在金陵，在木志乐老家丽江旅游，改天请木志乐吃大餐。
电话没挂断多久，木志乐再次打来电话，班花莫轻舞，昨天中午答应参加班级聚餐，也帮忙垫付了二十大洋餐费，白天不参加班级活动也就算了，答应好的聚餐也不参加，言而无信，出尔反尔，，，
你还是不是男人？好吧，驾照、户口本、护照等证件在宿舍，那就回宿舍拿些东西，顺便参加班级聚会，反正以后很少会回学校。
天福园在校门口童家巷美食街，几十年的老字号饭店，饭菜味道不错，生日宴会或班级聚餐首选之地，人均消费十元左右，价格颇为亲民。
“江凡，速度挺快的嘛，二十分钟从丽江赶到金陵，两千多公里，你是坐导弹来的？”
班头张海莹恨不得一巴掌拍死江凡，一个多月没上过一节课，难得全班学生一起郊游，郊游不参加也就算了，班级聚餐也不参加，那干脆辍学算了。
这就有些尴尬了，刚进天福园便碰到从楼上下来的班头，江凡客气拱手道：“不才，姓江，名凡，字曹操，我从未告诉别人我的字号，班头，你是怎么知道的？”

油嘴滑舌，张海莹狠狠瞪了眼江凡，挥手示意身后班里两个男生回去，向着饭店大门走去，好吧，江凡随即跟上，不就是搬箱饮料嘛。
“学院里的奖学金和助学金名额竞争非常激烈，你要是期末考不出好成绩，学费全免和半免的名额，恐怕也轮不到你头上。”
“明白，最近赚了点小钱，不差那六千块学费。”
“你去替别人高考了？”
“这才六月份，我去替谁高考？”
“今年是高考时间调整的第一年，由原来的七月份提前至六月份，你说你每天都在忙些什么？”
张海莹无语吐槽，不上课，不玩游戏，不谈恋爱，也不兼职，真心搞不懂江凡每天在干些啥。
忙什么，忙着修炼呗，很快来到附近较大一家超市，一件大瓶果粒橙，一件大瓶雪碧，一手一件，拎起来轻轻松松。
工地搬砖？开什么玩笑，哥今天买药材花费了近百万，搬七八十年赚也不见得能赚一百万。
尼玛，也不知道谁选的饭店，中药一班和生命一班同在天福园三楼举办班级聚餐，江凡上楼时差点与前女友温美娟撞了个满怀，不知道的还以为两人旧情复燃，那是一个尴尬。
“老木，生命一班怎么也在天福园聚餐？”
木志乐无语瞥了眼江凡，天福园的饭菜物美价廉，三楼可接纳班级聚餐，那肯定是班级聚餐的首选饭店，随即打趣道：“告诉你个好消息，相逢即是缘，晚餐结束后，咱班和生命一班举办联谊活动！”
“卧槽，谁丧心病狂提出搞联谊活动？”
“你前女友的现男友！”
木志乐玩味看着江凡，上个月江凡的冒牌女友恶心了温美娟，人家温美娟的男朋友肯定要找回场子，时间还来得及，可以喊那个冒牌女友来救场。
“其行可鄙，其心可诛！”
“确实，那傻逼的确够贱！”
“我说的是你！”
“卧槽，天地良心啊，谁知道你什么时候勾搭上了班花，你们发展到哪一步了？”
木志乐佩服竖起大拇指，不愧是被雷劈过的男人，连女神莫轻舞对雷哥也有意思。

发展你妹啊，哥与莫轻舞关系不熟，莫轻舞帮忙垫付聚餐费用，又喊他必须参加班级聚会，无事献殷勤……

content_en:
After Su Sirong left, Jiang Fan leisurely admired his villa No. 6, which was decorated in pure European luxury style. There was a wine cellar and storage room in the basement. The first floor was the foyer, living room, kitchen, dining room, bedrooms, etc., the second floor was the living area, and the third floor was the work and rest area.
It's quite good. The kitchen and dining room are fully equipped with daily necessities, and all the furniture in the bedroom, study room, living room and other rooms are also fully equipped. You can just turn on the fire and cook when you move in, but it's just too deserted to live in a villa alone.
When you come to the rooftop of the villa, you can have a panoramic view of Xuanwu Lake Park. You can overlook the Gulou District, Xuanwu District, Qinhuai District and Pukou District across the Yangtze River. Maybe this is what the developer calls the domineering one.
There should be no spirit stones on the earth. I don’t know if there are other materials for setting up the array. If there are materials, I can set up a spirit gathering array. It can be considered a very good place for cultivation!
While running the "Chaos Creation Art" with his eyes closed, dense threads of spiritual energy were attracted from all directions, lingering around Jiang Fan, slowly entering his body, and his jade-like skin shimmered under the sunlight.
Not long after, Su Sirong returned to Villa No. 6 again. She was very considerate. Not only did she buy rosewood plaques, carving tools, the Four Treasures of the Study, etc., but she also bought bedding, daily necessities, and rice, flour, grain, and oil kitchen supplies, which saved Jiang Fan the trouble of purchasing supplies.
When Jiang Fan carved the plaque, he needed calligraphy copying. He poured his spiritual power into the carving knife and formed the four characters "Cangxuan Xiaoyuan" under his chin in one go. He then used a small carving knife to simply repair and perfect it. The dragons and phoenixes danced and penetrated into the wood. It was quite domineering when hung on the door of the villa!
After a brief tidying up, Jiang Fan carried two bags of cash and rushed straight to the HSBC branch in Xinjiekou, withdrew a check worth millions in cash, and reopened an account at the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China next door. The huge sum of 2 million in cash shocked many people, and also experienced ICBC's exclusive VIP service.
Instead of wandering around the Xinjiekou business district, Jiang Fan rushed to the Shuiximen Traditional Chinese Medicine Wholesale Market and spent more than 100,000 to purchase a dozen common medicinal materials. He also went to Caomu Tang to spend more than 800,000 to purchase musk, deer antlers and other precious medicinal materials. In less than two hours, he spent nearly 1 million, which was enough to collect the body tempering liquid needed for a month's training.
A total of 2.24 million was extorted last night. The medicinal materials needed for body refining alone cost nearly one million in one month. The medicinal materials for the next month may exceed 2 million, and the bank card balance and cash are almost 1.3 million. I really can't afford it.
It is very inconvenient to live in Zixuan Villa without a means of transportation. Cheap cars will lower the quality of the Villa. Expensive cars are a waste of money. Motorcycles seem to be a good choice. There are no traffic jams, parking is convenient, and it saves fuel and saves money.
There is no need to be too showy. I spent more than 8,000 to buy a Yamaha motorcycle, carrying two sacks of medicinal materials at a fast speed. It almost blinded the security guard of Zixuan Villa. When he learned that Jiang Fan was the new owner of Villa No. 6 that had been idle for many years, he was even more confused. Villa No. 6 was a taboo existence, and the new owner was actually a young man under the age of twenty!
Just after returning to the villa, before the motorcycle stopped, the mobile phone rang. It was a call from his class friend Mu Zhile. Everyone in the class had spent a day playing in Purple Mountain and had a dinner in Tianfu Garden half an hour later, urging Jiang Fan to go back to school early.
Now that I finally have a new home, I still have to practice in the precious time in the evening. How can I have time to attend some class dinners? I decisively replied that I was not in Jinling and was traveling in Mu Zhile's hometown of Lijiang. I would treat Mu Zhile to a big dinner another day.
Not long after the call was hung up, Mu Zhile called again. The class beauty, Mo Qingwu, agreed to attend the class dinner at noon yesterday, and also helped pay twenty yuan for the meal. It was okay not to participate in class activities during the day, and he also did not attend the promised dinner. He broke his promise and went back on his promise.
Are you still a man? Okay, driver's license, household register, passportWhen the certificate is in the dormitory, I will go back to the dormitory to get some things and attend the class party. Anyway, I will rarely go back to school in the future.
Tianfuyuan is located in the food street of Tongjiaxiang at the school gate. It is a time-honored restaurant with decades of history. The food is delicious. It is the first choice for birthday parties or class gatherings. The per capita consumption is about ten yuan, and the price is quite affordable.
"Jiang Fan, you're pretty fast. It takes 20 minutes to get from Lijiang to Jinling. It's more than 2,000 kilometers. Did you come here by missile?"
The class leader Zhang Haiying wanted to slap Jiang Fan to death. She hadn't attended a class in more than a month. It was rare for the whole class to go on an outing together. If she didn't participate in the outing, forget it. If she didn't attend the class dinner, she might as well drop out of school.
This was a bit embarrassing. As soon as I entered Tianfu Garden, I met the class leader who came down from upstairs. Jiang Fan politely raised his hand and said, "Bucai, my surname is Jiang, my given name is Fan, and my courtesy name is Cao Cao. I have never told anyone my trade name, class leader, how do you know that?"
With a smooth tongue, Zhang Haiying glared at Jiang Fan, waved to the two boys in the class behind her, and walked towards the hotel door. Well, Jiang Fan followed immediately, just to move the drinks.
"The competition for scholarships and bursaries in the college is very fierce. If you don't get good grades in the final exam, you may not be able to get the full or partial tuition exemption."
"I understand. I have made a little money recently, so I don't need the 6,000 yuan tuition."
"You went to take the college entrance examination for someone else?"
"It's only June, who am I going to take the college entrance examination for?"
"This is the first year that the college entrance examination time has been adjusted. It has been moved up from July to June. What do you think you are busy with every day?"
Zhang Haiying complained speechlessly. She didn't go to class, play games, fall in love, or work part-time. She really didn't understand what Jiang Fan was doing every day.
What are you busy with? You are busy practicing. Soon you arrived at a larger supermarket nearby. There was a large bottle of Orange and a large bottle of Sprite, one in each hand. You could easily carry them.
Moving bricks on a construction site? Are you kidding me? I spent nearly a million on buying medicinal materials today. I may not be able to earn a million even if I move here in 70 or 80 years.
Damn, I don’t know who chose the restaurant. The Chinese Medicine Class 1 and the Life Class 1 held a class dinner on the third floor of Tianfu Garden. Jiang Fan almost bumped into his ex-girlfriend Wen Meijuan when he went upstairs. Those who didn’t know thought that the two had rekindled their old relationship, which was an embarrassment.
"Lao Mu, why are the Life Class 1 also having dinner at Tianfu Garden?"
Mu Zhile glanced at Jiang Fan speechlessly. The food in Tianfu Garden is high quality and cheap. The third floor can accommodate class dinners. It must be the first choice restaurant for class dinners. Then he joked: "I'll tell you good news. Meeting is fate. After dinner, our class and Life Class 1 will hold a social event!"
"Damn it, who is so crazy as to propose a social event?"
"Your ex-girlfriend's current boyfriend!"
Mu Zhile looked at Jiang Fan in amusement. Last month, Jiang Fan's fake girlfriend disgusted Wen Meijuan. Wen Meijuan's boyfriend must get back together. There is still time, and he can call the fake girlfriend to save the situation.
"His actions are despicable and his intentions are despicable!"
"Indeed, that idiot is really cheap!"
"I'm talking about you!"
"Damn it, my conscience, who knows when you hooked up with the class girl and how far you have progressed?"
Mu Zhile gave him a thumbs up in admiration. He was indeed a man who had been struck by lightning. Even the goddess Mo Qingwu was interested in Brother Lei.
Develop your sister. Brother and Mo Qingwu are not familiar with each other. Mo Qingwu helped pay for the dinner party and told him that he must attend the class party and show his courtesy for nothing...
